resources.string: Scan the QR code the machine is showing, or type its device ID.
Allow the camera to scan a QR code
The camera is turned off for this app, and Android will not ask again. Allow it on the app\'s page in Settings to scan, or type the machine\'s device ID below.
That is not a machine device ID.
Only for a machine that cannot show a pairing code. Run this on the machine, once, to let this phone unlock it.
No pairing code? Enrol by hand
%1$s stays paired until a new pairing works.
Key held in StrongBox, the phone\'s secure element.
Key held in the Keystore. This phone has no StrongBox, so the key lives in the trusted execution environment instead. It still cannot be exported.
The machine has to be waiting at its unlock prompt before this will connect.
A machine is asking to be unlocked
Approving answers it with this phone\'s key, after a fingerprint or face check. Approve only if you are unlocking this machine now.
This is the machine this phone was paired with.
This is not the machine this phone was paired with.
Check the code on the machine
The machine is showing a code on its own screen. Only continue if it matches the one below; if it does not, someone else is asking.
Confirm it is you before answering %1$s.
Cancelled. Nothing was sent to the machine.
This phone has no usable biometric enrolled, so the key cannot be created or used. Enrol a fingerprint or a face in the phone\'s settings, then come back.
Too many attempts did not match, so the phone has locked its biometric sensor for a while. Wait a little, then try again. Nothing was sent to the machine.
Too many attempts did not match, so the phone has locked its biometric sensor until you unlock the phone with its PIN, pattern, or password. Do that, then try again. Nothing was sent to the machine.
The phone\'s biometric hardware cannot be used right now, so the key cannot be used either. Try again in a moment. Nothing was sent to the machine.
The connection to the machine was lost.
The machine connected but sent nothing to approve.
Could not reach the machine. Check that it is waiting at its unlock prompt, that this phone is online or on the same network, and that this phone is enrolled on it.
Could not reach the machine. Check that it is still showing its pairing code, and that this phone is online or on the same network.
The machine hung up. If it asked for a code, the code may not have matched, which can mean someone else is asking. Otherwise, try again.
The machine stopped answering. Try again.
The answer was sent, but the machine did not confirm whether it unlocked. Look at the machine: it may have.
The machine could not use this phone\'s answer, so it is still locked. This phone may no longer be enrolled on its disk.
The pairing code in that QR code is damaged or incomplete. Scan it again.
The machine did not accept the pairing code. Each code works only once, so scan the one it is showing now.
The machine\'s operator declined the pairing.
The machine sent something this phone will not act on, so nothing was answered.
Something unexpected went wrong. Try again; if it keeps happening, the details below help a bug report.
The fingerprint or face check ran out before the answer was ready, so nothing was sent. Try again.

This phone\'s key stopped working because a fingerprint or face was added to the phone, and the machine was not answered. The phone now has a new key: pair with the machine again. On the machine, revoke this phone\'s old device ID, %1$s, with unlocker enrol --remove.
